repair_steps: Locate Generator Primary Breaker
Engage manual breaker lever
GENERATOR_TRIP.workaround: Rely on limited auxiliary battery reserve
GENERATOR_TRIP.consequence: Total ship-wide power loss when batteries exhaust
GENERATOR_TRIP.narrative_clue: Vasquez locked breaker on manual override following orbit entry.

BUS_ISOLATION.root_cause: Distribution bus relay open due to electrical isolation protocol
repair_steps: Verify primary power active
Close distribution bus relay switch
BUS_ISOLATION.workaround: None; bus must be closed to route electricity
BUS_ISOLATION.consequence: Life support, doors, and flight consoles stay unpowered
BUS_ISOLATION.narrative_clue: Vasquez severed the main electrical distribution bus to isolate planetary interference.

COOLANT_COUPLER_FRACTURE.root_cause: Ceramic coupler fractured cleanly during orbital braking cavitation
diagnostic_method: Inspect coolant manifold in Life Support
repair_steps: Retrieve spare coupler from Engineering workbench
Insert into Life Support manifold
COOLANT_COUPLER_FRACTURE.workaround: Conserve activity to reduce oxygen consumption
COOLANT_COUPLER_FRACTURE.consequence: Asphyxiation when compartment oxygen drops to 0%
COOLANT_COUPLER_FRACTURE.narrative_clue: Chen placed two salvaged spare couplers in Engineering Bay storage.

COMMS_SERVO_DESYNC.root_cause: Antenna dish servo desynchronized; frequency drift from planetary pulse
repair_steps: Supply main bus electrical power
Execute frequency lock calibration on Bridge terminal
COMMS_SERVO_DESYNC.consequence: Unable to transmit distress signal or download flight telemetry
COMMS_SERVO_DESYNC.narrative_clue: Kharon-4 ELF radiation caused frequency drift in antenna servos.

CO2_SCRUBBER_SATURATION.root_cause: Chemical lithium-hydroxide absorption canisters saturated with carbonate crusting
symptoms: Atmospheric CO2 levels climbing above 2500 ppm
Crew fatigue, dizziness, and hypercapnia warning
diagnostic_method: Inspect scrubber column status beacon in Life Support
Read Atmospheric Diagnostics Console CO2 telemetry
Check Environmental Sensor in Life Support or Corridors
repair_steps: Path 1: Replace chemical cartridge at Life Support Scrubber panel
Path 2: Execute Scrubber Thermal Bake Purge override on Life Support terminal
Path 3: Open cross-ventilation dampers to disperse concentration
CO2_SCRUBBER_SATURATION.workaround: Open inter-compartment vent dampers or trigger terminal electrostatic bake
CO2_SCRUBBER_SATURATION.consequence: Acute CO2 toxicity, vision impairment, and eventual fatal acidosis
CO2_SCRUBBER_SATURATION.narrative_clue: Chen noted that scrubber bed lithium-hydroxide crystals were due for thermal regeneration bake.

CABIN_PRESSURE_LEAK.root_cause: Manifold gasket puncture venting cabin atmosphere into vacuum
symptoms: Audible gas jet hissing near Life Support manifold
Decompression alarm klaxon & HUD barometric alert
diagnostic_method: Locate acoustic hissing source in Life Support or Corridors
Check barometric pressure on wall environmental sensors
Inspect Ship Schematic decompression vector map
repair_steps: Path 1: Rotate emergency shutoff valve on leaking atmospheric line
Path 2: Close bulkhead doors to seal and isolate leaking compartment
Path 3: Trigger terminal emergency pressurization compensation feed
CABIN_PRESSURE_LEAK.workaround: Isolate affected compartment with bulkhead doors
CABIN_PRESSURE_LEAK.consequence: Complete cabin decompression, explosive ebullism, and hypoxia
CABIN_PRESSURE_LEAK.narrative_clue: Kharon-4 debris field peppered the external life support manifold during orbital braking.

THERMAL_RUNAWAY.root_cause: Heat exchanger proportional bypass valve jammed open; dumping reactor heat into ventilation
symptoms: Atmospheric temperature rising rapidly above 315 K (42°C)
Thermal warning klaxon and heat haze distortion
diagnostic_method: Inspect thermal exchanger piping in Life Support
Read climate loop diagnostic page on Engineering or LS terminal
repair_steps: Path 1: Turn manual radiator cooling bypass valve on Life Support manifold
Path 2: Issue terminal thermal reset / radiator flush override
Path 3: Shed electrical load / throttle reactor output
THERMAL_RUNAWAY.workaround: Ventilation damper thermal cross-bleed or terminal coolant cycle
THERMAL_RUNAWAY.consequence: Severe heatstroke, electronic malfunction, and thermal cabin cookoff
THERMAL_RUNAWAY.narrative_clue: Vasquez reported the bypass servo was binding whenever the primary turbine reached full excitation.

CONDUIT_BLOWN_FUSE.root_cause: Current spike severed thermal protection fuse link
symptoms: Flickering amber warning LED on conduit casing
diagnostic_method: Inspect conduit fuse bracket in Engineering Bay
repair_steps: Scan unit with Diagnostic Scanner to verify circuit parameters
Unclamp fuse housing with Multitool [2]
Insert Spare Fuse Pack into terminal bracket
Calibrate circuit impedance with Multitool [2]
Perform system diagnostic test
CONDUIT_BLOWN_FUSE.consequence: Auxiliary power disruption and secondary system flicker
CONDUIT_BLOWN_FUSE.narrative_clue: Chen noticed the surge from Kharon-4 popped the auxiliary protection fuses.

MANIFOLD_CLAMP_LOOSE.root_cause: Pneumatic coupling clamp loosened under thermal shock
symptoms: Coolant mist weeping from joint collar
repair_steps: Diagnose pressure drop with Diagnostic Scanner
Loosen clamp collar with Multitool [2]
Inject fresh coolant from Coolant Canister
Weld and torque clamp collar with Multitool [2]
Execute flow test
MANIFOLD_CLAMP_LOOSE.consequence: Gradual loss of thermal dissipation capacity
MANIFOLD_CLAMP_LOOSE.narrative_clue: Vibration loosened the high-pressure pneumatic clamps on header B.

SPECIMEN_CHAMBER_BREACH.root_cause: Mutant alien specimen tore through biological research chamber interlocks
symptoms: Scratching and claw impacts on bulkhead plating
Biometric lock shorted with creature venom
repair_steps: Isolate chamber security bus
Engage manual magnetic lockdown
SPECIMEN_CHAMBER_BREACH.workaround: Lure creature into adjacent decontamination chamber
SPECIMEN_CHAMBER_BREACH.consequence: Hostile predator loose in station corridors stalking the scientist
SPECIMEN_CHAMBER_BREACH.narrative_clue: Thorne noted the creature shredded the chamber's electronic lock.

TOXIC_GAS_LINE_ARMED.root_cause: Emergency poisonous gas decontamination line primed for creature trap
symptoms: Poisonous gas line pressure at 400 bar
Amber status glow on emergency isolation valve
repair_steps: Lure alien into decontamination chamber
Rotate emergency valve to discharge lethal gas
TOXIC_GAS_LINE_ARMED.workaround: None; only poisonous gas can exterminate the adapted creature
TOXIC_GAS_LINE_ARMED.consequence: Imminent ambush if the creature is not exterminated
TOXIC_GAS_LINE_ARMED.narrative_clue: Reyes rigged the poisonous gas line to flood the sealed chamber.
